description: This is a Java JUnit test class for the CredentialsClientImpl component in the Eclipse Hono client implementation. It tests various behaviors such as cache usage, service invocation, and error handling for credential retrieval.

classes.name: CredentialsClientImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the behavior of CredentialsClientImpl, including cache handling, service invocation, and error cases.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures before each test, mocks dependencies such as tracer, connection, sender, and cache.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsInvokesServiceIfNoCacheConfigured
methods.description: Verifies the credentials retrieval from the service when cache is not configured; also checks that no cache insert occurs.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsAddsResponseToCacheOnCacheMiss
methods.description: Ensures that on a cache miss, credentials are fetched from the service and added to the cache.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsReturnsValueFromCache
methods.description: Checks that when the cache contains credentials, they are returned directly without invoking the service.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsFailsWithSendError
methods.description: Verifies that the client fails appropriately if sending a request fails (e.g., queue full).

methods.name: testGetCredentialsFailsWithRejectedRequest
methods.description: Tests handling of a rejected message response indicating a failure in the credentials service.
